steps.en: Run the installer against any repo that ships SKILL.md packs
steps.zh: 对着带 SKILL.md 包的仓库跑一条安装命令

steps.en: Fetches the source and lists every valid skill it discovers inside
steps.zh: 拉取源仓库，发现并列出其中所有 skill

steps.en: Pick the skills and the target agents
steps.zh: 挑要装的 skill、目标 agent
steps.code: npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills -a claude-code -a opencode

steps.en: Detects installed agents and symlinks (or copies) the skill into each skills directory
steps.zh: 检测已装 agent，把 skill 软链或复制进各自目录

steps.en: Later, refresh every installed skill with one command
steps.zh: 之后一条命令批量更新全部 skill

value.en: Same skill pack installed and kept current across 79 agents without hand-copying directories
value.zh: 一条命令把同一个 skill 装进 79 个 agent 并保持更新，不再手工拷目录
